source: Public Java entity cuboids (MCreator / ModelRenderer addBox). Original BlockLegend colors, not official skins.
units: pixels, 16px = 1 block. Center xyz, Y-up, feet at 0, +Z face.

spider.note: Public SpiderModel: head 8x8x8, thorax 6x6x6, abdomen 10x8x12, EIGHT legs 12x2x2.

enderman.note: Public EndermanModel: head 8x8x8, body 8x12x4, arms/legs 2x30x2. About 2.9 blocks tall.

blaze.note: Public BlazeModel: head 8x8x8 + 12 rods 2x8x2 in 3 rings of 4. Eyes painted on head, not extra boxes.

ghast.note: Public GhastModel: body 16x16x16 + 9 tentacles 2xN x2 in 3x3 under the cube. Face painted on body.

warden.note: Public WardenModel: bone/body/head/arms/legs + left/right tendrils. Blind: no visor/eyes. ~2.9 blocks tall. Chest soul painted on body.

wither.note: Public WitherBossModel: center 8x8x8 + two 6x6x6 heads, shoulders, ribcage, hanging tail. FLOATING, no pedestal. Eyes painted on skulls.

dragon.note: Chunky academy wyrm from GPT four-view: 33 boxes, no micro-voxel grain.

storm.note: Story Mode Wither Storm cuboid reduction: dark mass, orange command-block heart, three mandible heads with ONE purple eye each, hanging tentacles. NOT a robed mage.

husk.note: Same public zombie/player cuboids as zombie spec. Sand-colored desert variant only.

ravager.note: Public RavagerModel: neck 10x10x18, head 16x20x16, snout 4x8x4, horns 2x14x4, jaw 16x3x16, body 14x16x20 (X-rotated), 4 legs 8x37x8. World-space reduction to ~2.2-block height.

phantom.note: Public PhantomModel: body 7x3x9, wing base 6x2x9 + tip 13x1x9, tail base 3x2x6 + tip 3x1x6. Wings combined to wingL/wingR for fourViewModel flap.

vex.note: Public VexModel after 1.19.3 Allay-like: small head 8x8x8, robe body 6x8x4, thin arms 2x8x2, wing slabs. Hitbox 0.4x0.8.

drowned.note: Same public zombie cuboids. Sea-green skin, mossy rags. Forward arms like zombie.

snowgolem.note: Public SnowGolemModel: pumpkin head 8x8x8, upper snow 8x8x8, lower snow 10x8x10. No stick arms in Java.

shulker.note: Public ShulkerModel: base 16x8x16, lid 16x4x16, head 6x6x6. Slightly open so the head peeks. Not a chest, not a shulker-box item only.

guardian.note: Public GuardianModel reduced: body 12x12x12, central eye, 4 cardinal spikes, two-part tail. Regular teal guardian, not elder brown.

pufferfish.note: Public Pufferfish large/puffed model: 12x12x12 body, side fins, a few spine nubs. Not the tiny unpuffed 4x4 form.

spore_bug.note: Original mushroom beetle. Body 10x6x12, head 6x5x6, six 2x4x2 legs, two antennae. Not a silverfish.

fire_spirit.note: Original hovering flame wisp. Core 6x8x6, flame 4x6x4, two ember rods. Not a Blaze.

sculk_worm.note: Original sculk caterpillar. Head 8x6x8 plus two body segments and tail. Not a Warden.

shadow_stalker.note: Original hooded hunter. Head 7^3, body 6x10x4, long arms, two legs. Not an Enderman.

pillager.note: Public IllagerModel: head 8x10x8, nose 2x4x2, body 8x12x6, arms/legs 4x12x4. Arms forward holding a wooden crossbow (not T-pose).

elder_guardian.note: Larger white sibling of guardian. Recolored from guardian four-view; not a GPT-approved verified sheet.

vindicator.note: Illager axeman. Pale head, olive coat, axe on the chest. Not a pillager, not a shulker.
